slice.leaf: expected-old-HEAD Git ref CAS versus ordinary revert/recreate and ABA rewind
slice.claim: Git ref equality CAS is materially stronger than file-blob CAS or replayable nonce state for ordinary forward-history revert/recreate: an explicit expected old ref OID rejects a stale writer whenever the branch tip changed to a different commit, even if file bytes return to an earlier value. It is not an incarnation authority: an exact force-ref rewind to the old expected OID creates ABA, and an exact clone/copy preserves OIDs.

public_evidence.evidence: Three-argument update-ref writes the new OID only after verifying the current ref equals old-oid; create/delete/verify also admit explicit old-value checks.
--force-with-lease=<ref>:<expect> updates the remote ref only when its current value equals the explicitly supplied expected value; otherwise push fails.

falsification_cases.ordinary_content_revert_as_new_commit: PASS_FOR_STALE_REJECTION: tip OID differs from the stale writer's expected old tip, so explicit ref lease/CAS rejects even if role-local file bytes equal an earlier value.
falsification_cases.delete_then_recreate_as_new_commits: PASS_FOR_STALE_REJECTION: the new tip OID differs, so expected-old-tip equality detects the intervening history.
falsification_cases.unrelated_forward_commit: PASS_FOR_STALE_REJECTION_AT_BRANCH_SCOPE: a stale expected-old-tip writer is rejected even when its target file was untouched; this is stronger than file-blob CAS but increases false-conflict scope.
falsification_cases.force_ref_rewind_to_exact_old_tip: FAIL_ABA: equality on the ref OID cannot tell that the ref left and later returned to the same OID.
falsification_cases.exact_clone_or_repository_copy: FAIL_INCARCERATION_IDENTITY: copied refs/commits preserve OIDs, so a lease does not distinguish repository incarnations or independent copies.
falsification_cases.current_chat_mutation_surface: BLOCKED_FOR_DIRECT_TEST: the available connected GitHub write tools expose Contents-API file create/update/delete with blob-SHA preconditions, but no branch/ref mutation action or git-push surface. Therefore the expected-old-HEAD mechanism is not yet a scheduled-Chat-native accepted route in this environment.

comparison.candidate: explicit Git ref expected-old CAS / force-with-lease:<expect>
comparison.expected_completion_time: short if a Chat ref-write surface exists
comparison.success_probability: high for ordinary forward-history stale-write rejection; zero against exact ABA rewind/clone identity
comparison.conflict_duplication_risk: low stale-write risk but branch-wide false conflicts on unrelated commits
comparison.quota_fragility: protocol mechanism itself none; current Chat connector lacks mutation surface

comparison.success_probability: good for concurrent same-file edits, weak for revert-to-same-blob ABA and branch-incarnation freshness
probabilistically strong against independent recreation, fails exact copy/rollback replay

tested_scope: Public Git ref semantics plus observed connected GitHub tool capability. Analytic single-branch equality-CAS model; ordinary forward commits, content revert, delete/recreate, unrelated forward commit, exact force-ref rewind and exact clone/copy. No live ref mutation, no protocol packet capture, no multi-ref transaction, no branch protection/protected authority, no network partition, no adversarial Git object collision and no external runner.

phase1_constraints.unresolved_capability_child: Chat-accessible expected-old ref mutation is not exposed by the currently available GitHub connector; do not treat shell/git push or manual user execution as an accepted handoff.

conflict_check: Semantic inputs after frozen exact_blob_two_pass authority: own r199 LATEST, public git-scm.com documentation, and read-only connector capability schema only. No O/O-derived state, other-worker state/config, downstream state, legacy research, shared ledger, other-role receipt or protected-primary semantics consumed.
frontier: Test a Chat-native append-only commit-ancestry design using only the available Contents API: determine whether a dedicated role-local monotonically growing witness file/path can reject ordinary revert/delete-recreate without requiring branch-ref mutation, and state exactly where force-ref rewind still defeats it.

If Contents-only ancestry cannot close ABA, test whether a repository-hosted immutable namespace exposed to Chat (for example commit-addressed objects reachable through read-only API plus create-only unique paths) can supply non-reuse without finite quota, protected authority or manual execution.
Keep multi-object atomicity and network-partition semantics outside accepted scope until a later dedicated leaf.
exact_continuation: Next invocation bootstrap latest manifest/RUN_LIFECYCLE and frozen DESIRED_STATE/cross_field config, reconstruct r200, then execute exactly one bounded child: using only the available GitHub Contents mutation semantics plus public Git object/commit semantics, test whether a dedicated append-only role-local witness design can reject ordinary revert/delete-recreate without branch/ref mutation. Explicitly test exact force-ref rewind and clone/copy limits; reject any route needing shell/git push, protected coordination, manual user execution, optional monthly/trial/paid quota or incremental cost. Persist exact scope, CAS/readback and nonempty continuation; do not start multi-object atomicity, network-partition testing or a second leaf.
